howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 golden_jupyter 笔记本中的代码示例、分析流程和最佳实践来回答数据分析和计算问题，并引用笔记本中的内容。
howto.when: 当你询问与 golden_jupyter 笔记本相关的数据分析、代码示例或方法时触发。

say.text: 请根据 golden_jupyter 笔记本解释数据分析流程。
say.note: Claude 会引用笔记本中的分析步骤。

say.text: 展示笔记本中 pandas 的使用示例。
say.note: Claude 会输出相关代码和输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer data analysis and computation questions based on code examples, analysis workflows, and best practices from the golden_jupyter notebook, citing its content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about data analysis, code examples, or methods related to the golden_jupyter notebook.

say_en.text: Explain the data analysis workflow from the golden_jupyter notebook.
say_en.note: Claude will reference the notebook's analysis steps.

say_en.text: Show the pandas usage example from the notebook.
say_en.note: Claude will output the relevant code and output.
